finding: The 2026-10-16 interpretation (routine executor startup/disposition messages kept on topic pipeline at ntfy priority 1) did not meet the preference: silent messages still appear in the owner's topic.
interpretation: Topic pipeline carries only plain-language lead messages for decisions, blockers and milestones. All automated executor startup/disposition notifications (including holds and failures) move to a separate topic pipeline-audit that the owner does not subscribe to (approval identity pipeline-audit-notification-approval-v1). The startup acknowledgement before job claims remains mandatory. Authorities already bound to the legacy pipeline profile may still deliver until they finish or expire; no new authorization binds it.
dependsOn: Ops provisioning of topic pipeline-audit and its publisher permission (Vikunja #89)
